comment.text: SHROOM1 P300 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Adrenocortical carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Hepatocellular carcinoma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting SHROOM1 residue P300 have been observed in hepatocellular carcinoma, adrenocortical carcinoma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma.
